# The High Street Journal

> > Ghana's trusted source for business, economy, finance, and news coverage with expert insights on trade, innovation, and governance.

The High Street Journal is a comprehensive news and analysis platform focused on Ghana's economy, business developments, and emerging sectors including fintech, agriculture, and mining. The publication features reporting on government compliance, entrepreneurship funding, legal insights, and digital economy trends across West Africa.

## Key Topics

- Ghana economy
- Government compliance
- Entrepreneurship funding
- Export-import trade
- Illegal mining (galamsey)
- Digital economy
- State entities
- Public financial management
- Business news
- Innovation and fintech
- Legal insights
- Agriculture sector
- Data protection
- Export financing
- Employment and careers

## News & Coverage

- [Latest Business & Economy News & Updates](https://thehighstreetjournal.com/hsj/business): Ghana business and economy news covering trade, agriculture, funding
- [Latest Ghana News & Updates](https://thehighstreetjournal.com/hsj/news): Latest Ghana news and updates on trade, policy, and business developments
- [Latest Work & Careers News & Updates](https://thehighstreetjournal.com/hsj/work-careers): Work and careers news covering entrepreneurship, skills, employment programs

## Analysis & Insights

- [Legal Insights & Updates](https://thehighstreetjournal.com/hsj/legal-insights): Legal insights on Ghana law, court decisions, employment, and disputes
- [Latest Innovation News & Updates](https://thehighstreetjournal.com/hsj/innovation): Innovation and tech news covering AI, fintech, digital economy in Ghana
- [Latest Opinions Articles & Essays](https://thehighstreetjournal.com/hsj/opinions): Expert opinion essays on Ghana economy, mining, aviation, and governance
- [Galamsey](https://thehighstreetjournal.com/galamsey): In-depth coverage of illegal mining, gold supply chain, environmental impact

## Government & Compliance

- [EPA, TOR, & Energy Ministry & 4 Others Top Gov't's PFM League Table as Most Compliant State Entities](https://thehighstreetjournal.com/epa-tor-energy-ministry-4-others-top-govts-pfm-league-table-as-most-compliant-state-entities): Government compliance ranking of state entities on public financial management
